findings.text: The F summary says calm conditions suffice, but `Calm.selectOne_subquery` also requires a calm projected expression and `Calm.aggregateOf_first` requires calm aggregate operands. Fix: Include these projection and operand premises in the retention requirement.

The calm check can compute on a statement containing variables, for example when a projected column has a variable index that the check never inspects. Fix: Distinguish an arbitrary expression whose syntax blocks reduction from a variable inside a known constructor.

The Q summary makes fault freedom an obligation for every caller, but `abs_where_unmodeled` uses `Quiet.selectOne` with a row on which `abs` may fail. Fix: Require separate fault evidence only when the caller needs a fault-free result.

The impact list omits checked Verso references outside group 2, including the reference to `resolveSources_tableInfo` in the docstring of `resolvePendingSources_pragma`, which would break on deletion. Fix: Include checked documentation references among the callers that a deletion must update.

A full catalog does not determine the lookup in `countOne_run` because its table name is also a variable. Fix: Limit the computation claim to known table names and preserve the lookup premise for callers with an arbitrary name.

Decision 1 makes a variable-filter derivation a prerequisite for every R law, although `resolveColumns_one` resolves the literal result column `1` for any scope and has no filter or catalog premise. Fix: Apply the variable-filter requirement only to laws whose statements depend on a filter.

The positive `IN` law proves equal truthiness, but an unmatched probe against an inner NULL can give `NULL` for `IN` and `0` for `EXISTS`. Fix: Correct both descriptions of decision 3 to distinguish positive filter truthiness from the negative law’s value equality under its non-NULL premises.

The list of count-subquery proofs omits `BalanceExample.count_run`, which evaluates `count(*)` in an arbitrary evaluation context while `countOne_run` uses a bound-parameter context. Fix: Include `BalanceExample.count_run` and preserve its arbitrary-context result when replacing the count definitions.
The status says the search covered all Lean and Python files at `1e8dfd8d`, but the record limits the scan to `packages`, `tests` and `tools`. Fix: Name those three directories in the status.
